last_checked.note: 2026-08-06 check: v6.0.0.26 (released 2026-08-06T17:13:06Z) vs prior-checked v6.0.0.24. Two intermediate releases (v6.0.0.25 on 08-04, v6.1.0.4 on 08-03) shipped between checks and were skipped -- comparing straight to latest per the skill's stated behavior, not a gap in this run. Only ~3h of production time on the new SHA at check time, so raw counts (info:123019 warn:140863 error:2781 critical:0) aren't directly comparable to the prior run's ~52h window; no critical logs at all this run (down from 33 previously). Rollout looks broad and healthy across all 18 clusters (production x4, staging x2, sandbox x1, 8 customer MPC/GCP clusters, preset x2). Sampled up to 1000 error/warn/critical log lines and cross-checked every message pattern that looked new against the previous SHA's full history -- every single one (permission-view-delete-refused RBAC cleanup noise, LogRestApi/Vector-DB-already-exists no-ops, backups_user check, LangChain deprecation warning, 'No type or annotation for parameter' AI-assist warning, generic report-generation warning wrapper, Slack files.upload API failures from the v1 API removal, cache-key misses) turned out to predate this release by weeks and were already present at comparable or higher volume on v6.0.0.24 -- they were just never sampled into known_noise before because /events/search only samples up to the page limit and rare patterns rotate in/out. Added 8 newly-confirmed-benign prefixes to known_noise this run. Two things NOT added to known_noise, carried forward as open items: (1) 'Problem upserting user preset|machine-<id> ... duplicate key value violates unique constraint ab_user_email_key ... machine@preset.io' -- continuous, near-one-per-second in production-aws-us1a/us2a, 613 occurrences in just the first ~2h of this SHA vs 13479 over the prior SHA's full ~7-day run (roughly 3.6x higher hourly rate). Pre-existing (not introduced by this release) but never triaged and rate looks elevated -- worth a real investigation into why many distinct preset|machine-* identities collide on one email. (2) Slack 'not_allowed_token_type'/'method_deprecated' report-notification failures, still present, consistent with the customer Slack v1 API removal flagged in the 07-30 note -- not worsening. The isolated Snowflake session error on prs_partnership_saos flagged 07-30 did not reappear in this window.
